items: The music stays in one dreamy mode (dorian) all run, still changing key between stages, its tunes now 8-bar melodies in a 32-bar shape: an instrument's tune, a sung answer, the tune again, a sung ending
The melodies are mostly slow, with long notes and triplets
Each 32 bars runs four-on-the-floor, four-on-the-floor, breakbeats, then a breakdown
A singing voice now carries half of every melody
The tempo stays at 120 all run, 5 faster each time you're knocked down
Knocked down, the record scratches and the music stops; back at your decks you drop the needle on a new record, scratch a little routine (different every time) and the new tunes start from the top
